reason: I'd self-host it the week it hits HN and play with it on a side repo, but I won't pay $99 a month for a pre-alpha from one developer, and I'm not letting agents loose on client code overnight yet.
objection: Unattended agents with our logins touching client repos at night is a security and liability risk, and a one-person pre-alpha has no track record or audit story.
would_change_my_mind: A clear sandboxing and permissions model I can show clients, plus a few months of other agencies running it safely.
